headline: Approved seven CPA Round 13 projects, an MOU extension, and March minutes
summary: The Community Preservation Committee reviewed Round 13 funding applications and approved funding for parks, housing, and historic preservation projects, including a disputed allocation to the Beverly Affordable Housing Trust. The committee also extended an MOU deadline, approved prior meeting minutes, and noted a City Solicitor letter for discussion at the next meeting.
decisions: Approved the Gillis Park Basketball Court Replacement project for $130,155 from the General Fund, 7-0.
Approved the Ahearn Park/Goldway Playground Renovation project for $250,000 from the General Fund, 7-0.
Approved the Gilbert Park/Bartlett Gardens Renovation project for $240,000 from the General Fund, 7-0.
Approved the Garden City Towers Fire Protection Sprinkler System Installation project for $825,645 total ($279,998.46 from Community Housing, balance from General Fund), 7-0.
Approved the Designate Housing Funds to the Beverly AHT project for $64,004 from the General Fund, with MOU conditions on CPA criteria review, 6-1.
Approved the Central Cemetery Tomb House project for $23,390 from the Historic Resources Fund, including HDC coordination, 7-0.
Approved the Central Cemetery Fence and Gates project for $237,000 from the Historic Resources Fund, 7-0.

Approved the Outbuilding Roof Replacement - The Garden School project for $25,672 total ($6,999.61 from Historic Resources Fund, balance from General Fund), with claw back clause and HDC coordination, 7-0.
Extended the R7-6 MOU for Greenenergy Park (Solar Now) to September 30, 2026, 7-0.
Approved the March 19, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 7-0.
